QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` (`constant_time_impl.h:42`) is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on and the compiler is GCC-like or ARM Compiler (`__GNUC__` / `__ARMCC_VERSION`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined in constant_time_impl.h from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros. That makes it derived, not set in mbedtls_config.h.
